questline.name: The Sundering of the Loom
questline.description: Meet the people of the Loom, raise a companion and loosen the old stitch that has forgotten how to let go.

chapter_1.name: First Stitch
intro: You find Maren mid-sentence, talking to her Barkley about something it clearly already knows.
She doesn't look up immediately.
When she does: *'Oh good. Another one. Sit down — Barkley, move over — and tell me what you've seen so far.'*
You tell her you're just starting.

*'Good,'* she says. *'Then you haven't learned any bad habits yet. I'm writing a new page of the Bestiary — the server's record of what exists here, officially. For that I need firsthand accounts. Not mine. I've been here too long. I see what I expect to see.'*
*'Go out three times. Pick a path you want to know better. Catch three companions and tell me what meeting them felt like. That's the part that goes in the record.'*

steps.description: Explore three times; choose your destination with /explore
Catch 3 wild beasts

completion_dialogue: *'Back already. Good. Sit down.'*
She listens to everything you say without interrupting. When you finish, she writes something in her book.

*'That thing you felt when it looked at you before you caught it — that pause — that's what the Loom feels like from the outside. Every beast is a question the Loom asked and then answered. You were there for the answer.'*
She closes the book.
*'The Bestiary page is written. Your name is in it — as the trainer present for these catches. That matters more than you know. The Loom keeps its own records, but ours are more legible.'*
She looks at you for a long moment.

*'There's a young man camped near the Celestial Loom. Cael. He's been trying to reach me for a week but his messages arrive in the wrong order — Twine's doing, probably. Find him. He seems worried about something.'*

chapter_2.name: Something's Off
intro: *'Oh — you're here. Right. I knew you were coming. That's not a skill, Twine just — anyway.'*
He glances at his Twine, who twitches an ear.
*'We need to talk about the fraying. You've noticed the fraying, right?'*
He looks at your face.
*'You haven't noticed the fraying.'*
He sits down on a rock that may or may not exist and runs a hand through his hair.

*'The Sundering events — the Altered Divines — they're accelerating. Three last month. One the month before. Before that, one every three months. The rate is wrong. Something is pulling at the Loom from somewhere I can't see, and when I try to follow the thread it goes into a place that Twine won't enter, which is the first time I've ever seen Twine refuse to go anywhere.'*

*'I need someone at the next Altered Divine event. Someone who can hold the line while I watch what the Loom does when the thread snaps. I've been watching from too far away. I need to be closer. And I can't be closer if I'm also fighting.'*

steps.description: Reach trainer level 10 and visit the Celestial Loom
Participate in any raid

completion_dialogue: You find Cael after the raid, scribbling in a notebook that's already full.
*'I saw it. I saw what the Loom does when it snaps.'*
He stops writing.

*'It hesitates. Before the thread breaks, there's a moment where the Loom knows it's going to break and keeps pulling anyway. I don't know what that means. I've been thinking about it and I don't know what it means.'*
Twine puts a small paw on his arm.

*'Right. What I do know is that the Altered Divines are being pulled from the same direction each time. Not a biome — a direction. Southwest of the Ember Wastes. There's nothing there. Or there's nothing that used to be there.'*
*'Talk to Sable. She's been in the Ember Wastes longer than anyone. If something changed out there, she'd know. She's — she can be a lot. Just be direct. She respects direct.'*

chapter_3.name: Sable's Price
intro: The forge is loud and orange and smells like metal and something older than metal.
Sable doesn't look up when you arrive.
*'If Cael sent you, you can start talking. If you wandered in on your own, sit down and wait until I'm done with this.'*
You mention Cael.
*'Figures.'*
She sets down her tools. Her Hellhound opens one eye.

*'Yes, I've noticed something. Southwest of here the ground sounds different when you walk on it. Hollow. Like something underneath it stopped. I've been ignoring it because I don't do Loom business.'*
She picks her tools back up.

*'I'll forge the first component of whatever Cael's building. But I need Phoenix Ash — real Ash, not shop-grade. That means you go into the Wastes and you catch something that lives here. A Phoenix. A Wyvern. A Dragon, if you can manage it. Bring me what they drop. Then we'll talk.'*

steps.description: Catch a Phoenix, Wyvern, or Dragon in the Ember Wastes
Obtain Phoenix Ash (drops from exploring the Ember Wastes)

completion_dialogue: Sable takes the Phoenix Ash and examines it for a long moment.
*'Good quality. You found the good stuff.'*
She starts working immediately, without further ceremony.
Twenty minutes later she holds up something small and warm. It pulses faintly, like it's breathing.

*'Ember Relic. One of four. I made it from what the Wastes gave you and what you brought me. That's how Relics work — they're not made from materials, they're made from attention. The materials are just the medium.'*
She holds it out.
*'That hollow spot southwest of here. It appeared about four months ago, same time as your Sundering acceleration. I haven't gone to look at it because I don't want to know. But I think you should.'*
A pause.
*'Orren is in the Whispering Woods. He's old enough to know what it is. Tell him I said hello. Tell him I still disagree with him about the Architects. He'll know what that means.'*

chapter_4.name: What Orren Remembers
intro: Orren is sitting very still when you find him, watching something you can't see.
His Dryad's vines are slightly brighter than usual, which you will later learn means she's paying attention.

Eventually: *'The Whispering Woods have been here since the second day of weaving. I've been here since the fourth. I saw the first Sundering happen. It was quiet. That surprised me. I thought something that large would make more noise.'*
He looks at you properly.
*'Sable says hello. And she still disagrees about the Architects.'*
Something that might be amusement crosses his face.
*'She's always disagreed. She's not wrong, exactly. She's just looking at the same thing from underneath, where it all looks like materials and heat.'*
He folds his hands.

*'I know about the hollow spot southwest of the Wastes. I've known about it for four months. Before I tell you what I know, I want to see your Bestiary. Not to judge — to understand what kind of attention you're bringing to this. The relics respond to attention. They always have.'*

steps.description: Discover 12 species in this server's Bestiary
Return to Orren with your Bestiary progress

completion_dialogue: Orren looks at your Bestiary for a long time.
*'You kept a record. Good. Enough different lives to know that no one shape is the right one.'*
He stands, slowly, and the Dryad's vines shift to make room.

*'Before the biomes had names, the Architects left markers. Not deliberately — they were places where something important was decided. The Whispering Woods has one: a place where Pillar said, 'this part holds.' It's under a root cluster three hours north of here. I've been watching it since the second Sundering.'*
He hands you a small, smooth stone that feels heavier than it should.

*'This is the Whispering Relic. The stone knows where it came from. If you bring it back to the Celestial Loom along with the other three, The Archivist will be able to tell you what the hollow spot is.'*
He pauses.
*'The Archivist already knows. But they're the kind of being that waits to be asked before they answer. You'll understand when you meet them.'*

*'The other two relics are in the Glacial Hollows and the Sunken Abyssal Trenches. The Trenches one is harder to find. You'll need to go deep. The beast you find there will lead you to it, if you let it.'*

chapter_5.name: The Archivist
intro: A corridor of low stars leads to a library. The Archivist looks up from a book that has not yet been written.
*'Two relics. Two acts of attention. There are two more: one in the Glacial Hollows, one in the Trenches. Follow the marks; the places remember being held together.'*

Their Paradox sits beside an empty chair. *'The hollow southwest of the Wastes is an old protective stitch. It has tightened around creatures it was meant to shelter. It needs help learning to let go. Bring back the other relics, and I will give you something that can take root there.'*

steps.description: Find the Glacial Relic in the Glacial Hollows (explore until discovered)
Find the Trench Relic in the Sunken Abyssal Trenches
Return to the Archivist with all four relics

completion_dialogue: You lay all four relics on the table. They settle into the shape of a small, open circle.
*'There. A place that can hold without closing,'* says the Archivist. They set a World-Tree Seed in your hands.

*'Hatch this with /incubate, then care for it with /tend. A Pillar will remember how to leave room for another life. Take it to Cael. He has been trying to loosen the stitch by pulling harder. You can imagine how that has gone.'*
Paradox presses its nose into your palm. The library, for once, waits for you to leave before rearranging itself.

chapter_6.name: The Fraying
intro: Cael is standing at the edge of the Loom's light when you find him, not watching it. Watching the place where it stops.
*'I've been tracking something,'* he says, without looking away. *'A gap in the pattern. Small. The kind of thing you'd only notice if you were already looking for something else.'*
His Twine tugs his ear.

*'Right, right — I'll tell them. There's a beast that's been acting strange. Not corrupted — that's different. Corrupted beasts know something happened to them. This one acts like it doesn't know what it is anymore. Like the Loom revised it mid-sentence and forgot to finish.'*
*'I need you to find it. It won't come to me. I've tried. But you — you're new here. The Loom hasn't filed you under anything yet. It might let you close enough to look.'*

steps.description: Explore the Celestial Loom 3 times
Befriend the Loom Fragment; the third Loom exploration reveals it if you have not met one

completion_dialogue: The Loom Fragment asks Cael whether a question can have a name.
*'Yes,'* he says, after thinking about it. *'We can call you Thread, if you like.'*
Thread folds a loose end around your wrist. Twine puts one paw on the knot and stops the ticking for a moment.

*'It wasn't the Loom revising it,'* Cael says. *'The old stitch is trying to protect everything at once. It holds so tightly that nothing can finish changing. Thread found the loose end. Now we know where to begin.'*

chapter_7.name: Sable's Debt
intro: Sable isn't at her forge when you arrive. She's sitting outside it, which you've never seen before, looking at something she's holding in both hands.
When she hears you, she closes her hand around it before you can see what it is.
*'I need something made,'* she says. *'I'd do it myself but — this one I can't. The materials won't work for me. That happens sometimes with forge work. The metal knows who it's for.'*
*'It's for someone I owe. I've owed it for a long time. They stopped asking but the debt didn't go anywhere, just — sat there, being a debt. I'm tired of it sitting.'*
She gives you a list of materials without looking up.
*'Bring those back. I'll tell you what you're making when you're here with them. It's not a complicated item. It's just one that matters.'*

steps.description: Collect 5 Hellhound Ember and 3 Dragon Scale
Craft any 2 items

completion_dialogue: The clasp Sable makes is simple: two leaves that meet without locking shut.
*'It's for Maren. She gave me her coat the night my first forge burned. I promised I'd mend its clasp. I built two forges and led a guild before I remembered that promise.'*
You carry it to Maren together. Sable fastens it to the old coat without asking for thanks.
Maren tests the catch, then opens it again. *'A good clasp knows when to let go.'* Sable looks at you. Neither of you has to mention the hollow.

chapter_8.name: What the Woods Forgot
intro: Orren is waiting for you at the edge of the woods where the light changes.
*'Maren sent word,'* he says. *'She doesn't usually do that. We've been — we've been not-talking to each other for about twelve years. On purpose. It was the right decision at the time.'*
He pauses. Something moves in the trees and he watches it pass with the particular attention of someone who knows what it is and is thinking about something else entirely.
*'She wants to finish a conversation. The one we stopped. I think she's right that it's time. But I'd like — I'd like you to be there. As a witness. The Loom values witnessed things.'*

*'Before that, I need you to do something for me. Go into the woods. Catch something old. Not ancient — just old. Something that remembers a version of this place I remember too. Bring it back and show me what you found. Then we'll go see Maren.'*

steps.description: Explore the Whispering Woods twice
Win 3 battles
Meet a Fairy, Dryad, Centry or Behemoth from the old woods

completion_dialogue: Maren sets out three cups. Orren looks at his for a long time.
*'I wrote your name out of the record,'* Maren says. *'I thought that was how to respect your wish to be forgotten.'*
*'I wanted that one mistake forgotten,'* Orren says. *'Not the years before it. I should have said so.'*
Maren opens a blank page. *'Tell me what belongs here.'* He begins with the old woods, and then the first creature he failed to help. This time she writes the whole account.
You keep the kettle warm. There are no witnesses standing above this conversation; there are three people making enough room to finish it.

chapter_9.name: The Corrupted
intro: Sable has spread Cael's notes across her forge bench. Thread keeps one corner from curling.
*'They aren't becoming cruel,'* she says. *'They're caught in the same protection loop. The old stitch feels them struggling and holds tighter. We mistook a grip for an enemy.'*
*'Fight beside your guild twice more. Give them room to breathe. Watch when the corrupted shapes loosen; that is the rhythm we'll use at the hollow.'*

steps.description: Help stabilize two Corrupted raids
Contribute 3,000 total raid damage; attacks and ultimates both count

completion_dialogue: You show Sable the pauses between the attacks. Cael taps them on the bench. A rhythm, not a weakness.
*'A clasp knows when to open,'* she says. *'A record knows what to keep. A thread knows how to wait. Orren can show us where to plant.'*
She closes her tools. *'Bring the Pillar from your seed. We're going southwest.'*

chapter_10.name: Room to Grow
intro: The hollow is smaller than the stories made it. A root has grown in a tight circle around a knot of frightened light.
Your Pillar settles beside it. Maren opens the repaired clasp. Orren puts both hands on the soil. Cael waits for Twine's signal. Sable sets down her tools.
*'We are not pulling this open,'* says the Archivist. *'We are making somewhere safe for it to open into.'*
*'When you are ready, choose what you will bring to that place: care, curiosity, or courage. The answer changes how we begin. All three leave room for the creature to choose.'*

steps.description: Reach trainer level 15
Care for a collection of 12 beasts
Hatch the World-Tree Seed with /incubate and /tend
Help stabilize a raid

completion_dialogue: The Pillar's roots find the ground beneath the knot. They grow outward, leaving a gap where the light can move.
The old stitch loosens. Not a snap; a breath. A small creature steps free, looks back at the shelter that held it too tightly, and decides to stay nearby.
Thread asks if this is what growing means. *'Part of it,'* Maren says. Sable's Hellhound settles by the new roots. Orren sits beside it.
The Archivist closes the book they brought. *'This part is finished. The hollow is a place to begin again, now. You did that together.'*
On your next visit to the woods, the wind reaches a place that used to be still. Your companion notices it first.

care.label: Care — make a shelter
care.title: Keeper of Gentle Things
care.scene: You kneel beside the knot and wait. Your companion rests its head against your hand. The first loose loop opens toward the shelter you have made.

curiosity.label: Curiosity — listen to the thread
curiosity.title: Listener to the Loom
curiosity.scene: You follow Thread's questions instead of its tangles. The knot answers in little pulses. Cael hears the rhythm, and the first loop opens without being pulled.

courage.label: Courage — hold the opening
courage.title: Guardian of the Open Path
courage.scene: You stand where the knot is tightest and hold the safe space steady. Your companion takes the other side. The first loop opens, and neither of you closes it again.
